item.name: Requirements - run after seed, before mutation checks
A1 - inspect JSON (verify SQL schema separately)

exec: const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Case insensitive and ordered', () => { pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.least(2); rows.forEach(x => pm.expect(x.lastName.toLowerCase()).to.eql('niyonzima')); pm.expect(rows.map(x=>x.firstName)).to.eql(rows.map(x=>x.firstName).sort()); });

const rows = pm.response.json(); pm.test('Status and date order', () => { rows.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.status).to.eql('SUBMITTED')); pm.expect(rows.map(x=>x.forecastDate)).to.eql(rows.map(x=>x.forecastDate).sort()); });
const ids = pm.response.json().map(x=>x.id); pm.test('Distinct farmers', () => pm.expect(new Set(ids).size).to.eql(ids.length));

const row = pm.response.json().find(x => x.harvestForecast.id === pm.collectionVariables.get('forecast2')); pm.test('Seed record exists', () => pm.expect(row).to.exist); if (row) pm.collectionVariables.set('ticket1', row.id);
pm.test('Page metadata', () => { const p = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.be.at.least(10); pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.be.at.least(2); pm.expect(p.content.length).to.eql(5); });
